description: This is a test class for the ConnectionValidator in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing various validation scenarios for connection configurations including addresses, acknowledgements, certificates, payload mappings, and host restrictions.

classes.name: ConnectionValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for testing the ConnectionValidator class, focusing on validation logic for connection configuration correctness and security restrictions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the ConnectionValidator class is immutable.

methods.name: acceptValidConnection
methods.description: Tests that a well-formed connection passes validation.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithSourceWithoutAddresses
methods.description: Ensures the validator rejects connections with sources lacking address information.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithInvalidSourceDeclaredAcks
methods.description: Checks that invalid acknowledgement labels in sources cause validation to fail.

methods.name: acceptConnectionWithPlaceholderPrefixedSourceDeclaredAck
methods.description: Verifies connections with placeholder acknowledgment labels are accepted.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithEmptySourceAddress
methods.description: Ensures sources with empty address fields are rejected.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithEmptyTargetAddress
methods.description: Ensures targets with empty addresses are rejected.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithInvalidTargetIssuedAck
methods.description: Checks rejection for invalid acknowledgment labels issued by targets.

methods.name: acceptConnectionWithValidSourceDeclaredAcksAndTargetIssuedAcks
methods.description: Validates that correct declared and issued acknowledgments are accepted.

methods.name: acceptConnectionWithValidSourceDeclaredAcksAndTargetIssuedAcksUsingPlaceholder
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment acceptance when using placeholders.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithInvalidNormalizerMapperJsonFieldSelector
methods.description: Verifies invalid JSON field selectors in normalizer mappers cause validation failure.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithIllFormedTrustedCertificates
methods.description: Ensures malformed certificates are rejected.

methods.name: acceptConnectionWithTrustedCertificates
methods.description: Checks that a properly formatted trusted certificate chain is accepted.

methods.name: rejectIllFormedClientCertificate
methods.description: Ensures improperly formatted client certificates are rejected.

methods.name: rejectIllFormedClientKey
methods.description: Checks that malformed client private keys are rejected.

methods.name: acceptClientCertificate
methods.description: Verifies that valid client certificates are accepted.

methods.name: testInvalidHosts
methods.description: Tests the validation for various invalid hostnames such as wildcards, blocked IPs, loopback, private, and multicast addresses.

methods.name: expectConnectionConfigurationInvalid
methods.description: Helper to assert that validation throws an exception for invalid connections.

methods.name: getConnectionWithHost
methods.description: Creates a connection object with the specified host for testing host validation.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates a standard connection object for testing.
